census_contract.untracked_boundary_rule: The summary command must first enumerate every nonignored untracked root/file without recursive descent. Root-level files are always scanned. A directory record is legal only when its first POSIX segment is an exact configured root, or when that first segment starts with one exact operational prefix and the top-level object lstat is a directory. Configured roots are recursively expanded by git_untracked_argv. Operational-prefix directories are not descended and are contractually denied all product/canonical/writer authority. Every other untracked directory record fails unknown_untracked_root; therefore backend/new_state_store.py is discovered and new_domain/state_store.py fails closed rather than remaining invisible.
census_contract.configured_root_rationale: All Git-tracked repository paths are inventoried. Every root-level untracked file and all nonignored untracked files beneath established tracked domains plus backend/mockups are inventoried. Foreign test basetemps, attachment staging and output workspace directories are an explicit deny-authority boundary, while every unknown top-level untracked directory fails closed. On the current checkout all three exact commands complete with exit 0 and empty stderr without touching foreign temp contents.
census_contract.git_output: Run all three exact commands. Capture stdout and stderr separately as bytes. Any nonzero exit code OR any nonempty stderr byte is the fixed git_inventory_failed error, even when Git exits 0, because warnings make closed-world enumeration unprovable. Otherwise split stdout on NUL, reject empty interior records, decode each path as strict UTF-8 and emit only normalized POSIX paths. Apply untracked_boundary_rule to the summary. Candidate input is the union of tracked paths, expanded configured-root untracked paths, and summary root-level files; duplicate normalized paths collapse only when byte-identical across command outputs.
census_contract.candidate_boolean: A non-excluded regular file is a candidate when it is one of the ten exact mandatory_post_r3_discovery_candidates OR its normalized path contains any path pattern OR, for a listed text suffix decoded as strict UTF-8, its content contains any content pattern. The ten mandatory paths form an unconditional candidate union and each must exist with its exact declared raw blob; absence or drift is identity_mismatch. A path-pattern or mandatory match that is oversized, binary, non-UTF-8 or unreadable is a closed scan error; content scanning never silently skips a listed suffix.
census_contract.binary_predicate: Bytes are binary iff they contain at least one NUL byte 0x00. If no NUL exists, strict UTF-8 decode determines text validity and all decoded control code points are searchable text; no other byte or Unicode heuristic is permitted. This keeps tracked UTF-8 vendor bundles with embedded non-NUL control bytes scannable while still rejecting NUL-bearing payloads exactly.
census_contract.path_safety: For the repository root and every path component use lstat; reject symlinks and on Windows any FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT including junctions. Require a regular final file, strict resolved commonpath containment, exact PurePosix round-trip without absolute, dot, dot-dot, backslash or colon segments, and unique Unicode NFKC-casefold identity.
census_contract.toctou: Capture every component lstat identity (device, inode when nonzero, size, mtime_ns and Windows attributes); open the final path once with os.open using O_RDONLY, O_BINARY/O_NOINHERIT where available and O_NOFOLLOW where available; require fstat regular-file identity to match the captured final lstat; read only from that descriptor; compare fstat after read and every component lstat after close. Reject and discard candidate content on any mismatch. Threat boundary: this verifier detects ordinary/concurrent repository mutation but is not a filesystem sandbox and does not claim to prevent a malicious privileged component-swap race on Windows. It scans only repository code/text inventory, never runtime DATA_DIR, private data or provider/network state; run against a quiescent trusted checkout.
census_contract.raw_identity: Compute lowercase SHA-1 of b'blob ' + ASCII decimal byte length + NUL + exact raw bytes. Do not use path-filtered Git hashing. A missing, new, removed or changed manifest member fails closed.
census_contract.discovery_result: The first real-repository candidate manifest must contain the 17 seeded entries plus every additional detected candidate as classification=unclassified. No writer may invent a disposition. Default validation exits 2 while any unclassified entry exists; --expect-unclassified exits 0 only when scan completeness, exact identities and at least one unclassified entry are proven.
census_contract.no_writeback: Projection, cache, fixture, worker and harness entries never gain Harbour canonical write authority.
census_contract.output: Deterministic JSON only; no file mutation, migration, database access, provider/network access or private-data read.

manifest_contract.exclusion_rule: These three artifacts are outside the census denominator to avoid self-hash recursion. Their final raw candidate blobs are bound by the ABC claim and independent acceptance receipt; no other exclusion is legal.

manifest_contract.seed_mapping_rule: The 17 current_inventory_seed paths must be present exactly once with classification=state_bearing and the exact owner, writer_authority, role, disposition and reason declared by their path entry in seed_disposition_mapping. The historical inventory group is descriptive and does not substitute for the closed role value. Additional discovered candidates must be unclassified/unclassified/unclassified_no_writer/unclassified_candidate/requires_separate_reviewed_classification with the fixed reason 'Requires a separate reviewed disposition decision.'
manifest_contract.discovery_mode_closed_combinations: Only the exact 17 state_bearing seed mappings and the exact unclassified combination for every other discovered path are legal. stateless_allowlist is reserved for a later separately reviewed classification manifest and is rejected in discovery_snapshot mode.
manifest_contract.ordering_and_digest: Entries sort by UTF-8 path bytes. scan_contract_digest is SHA-256 of UTF-8 encoded canonical JSON for the exact census_contract object with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true and separators comma/colon. The report member_set_digest is SHA-256 of UTF-8 encoded canonical JSON array [[path,raw_blob],...] in entry order with ensure_ascii=false and separators comma/colon. Both digest values are exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters with no algorithm prefix. Golden vector: the member-set input [] encodes as UTF-8 bytes 5b5d and yields 4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945.

cli_contract.mode_rule: --discover forbids --manifest and --expect-unclassified, performs the same bounded scan, requires all ten exact mandatory path/blob pairs in its candidate union, emits every discovered candidate in deterministic order and exits 0 without writing. Validation requires --manifest; Root copies the discovery entries into the new manifest via the claimed file edit, retaining the 17 seeds as state_bearing and marking every other entry unclassified. Discovery and validation both fail identity_mismatch if any mandatory path is absent or its raw blob drifts. The CLI never creates or edits the manifest.

field_types.member_set_digest: JSON string exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
field_types.entries: JSON array of exact discovery entry objects
field_types.errors: sorted unique JSON array of strings from error_codes

cli_contract.canonical_output: Emit exactly one UTF-8 JSON object plus LF using ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true and separators comma/colon. No stderr output and no additional stdout text.
cli_contract.discovery_success: exit 0; status=complete; errors=[]; entries equal the complete sorted candidate set; files_enumerated equals the candidate-input file count after union; candidates_detected=len(entries); member_set_digest covers entries.
cli_contract.invocation_matrix: Exactly these invocations are valid: discovery has --discover, --format json, no --manifest and no --expect-unclassified; validation has exactly one --manifest PATH, --format json, no --discover, and optionally --expect-unclassified. Missing mode, both modes, duplicate options, missing/wrong format, unknown arguments or --expect-unclassified outside validation emit the fixed invalid-invocation report: exit 1, invalid_invocation_kind, invalid_invocation_report_fields_exact, status=invalid, files_enumerated=0, candidates_detected=0, member_set_digest=empty_member_set_digest, errors=["input_invalid"]. Argument-parser usage/help text is suppressed from stdout and stderr.
cli_contract.validation_complete: When scan and manifest match, unclassified_count=0 and --expect-unclassified is absent: exit 0; status=complete; errors=[]; candidates_detected=classified_count; counts and digest cover the complete candidate set. If --expect-unclassified is present while unclassified_count=0, emit the validation exit-one failure sentinel with errors=["manifest_mismatch"].
cli_contract.validation_expected_unclassified: When scan and manifest match, unclassified_count>0 and --expect-unclassified is present: exit 0; status=unclassified; errors=[]; candidates_detected=classified_count+unclassified_count; counts and digest cover the complete candidate set.
cli_contract.validation_unexpected_unclassified: When scan and manifest match, unclassified_count>0 and --expect-unclassified is absent: exit 2; status=unclassified; errors=["unclassified_candidates"]; candidates_detected=classified_count+unclassified_count; counts and digest cover the complete candidate set.
cli_contract.exit_one_failure: After a valid invocation selects a mode, any Git, path, schema, limit, read, identity or manifest failure exits 1 with that mode's kind and exact report fields, status=invalid, files_enumerated=0, candidates_detected=0, member_set_digest=empty_member_set_digest, and errors equal to the sorted unique nonempty set of applicable fixed codes. Discovery additionally has entries=[]; validation additionally has classified_count=0 and unclassified_count=0. Invalid invocations use invocation_matrix instead. No partial counters, paths or digests may leak.

exit_codes.0: complete discovery/validation, or exact unclassified validation when --expect-unclassified is set
exit_codes.1: closed input, path, I/O, identity, schema or scan error
exit_codes.2: exact validation contains unclassified candidates without --expect-unclassified

cli_contract.failure_output: Never emit raw file content, decoder/system exception text, absolute host paths or environment values. Errors are sorted unique fixed codes.
